svg.title: Full Chen-notation ER diagram for the College Management System
svg.desc: Department, Student, Course and Faculty entities with all attributes, primary keys underlined, a multivalued phone attribute, a composite name attribute for Faculty, and five relationships: Department has Student (1:N), Department offers Course (1:N), Department has HOD Faculty (1:1), Faculty teaches Course (1:N), and Student enrolls in Course (M:N) with semester and grade as relationship attributes.
